policy.textures: downsize only, never upscale; same image format and mime type; alpha and colour chunks kept
policy.meshopt: EXT_meshopt_compression, lossless: attribute codec v0, index codec v1, no filters, no quantisation, no reordering
policy.standaloneTextures: runtime-loaded images declared by current manifests and runtime configuration; whole-image downsize only (no crop, pad, repack or redraw), same format, alpha and colour chunks, premultiplied alpha, repeat-wrapped textures filtered across their edges; UV rectangles stay normalised by the source size
policy.provenance: deterministic derivatives of the adopted TRELLIS-lineage GLBs and of the audited cave images; not a new model or image generation; originals unchanged

standaloneImagesSkipped.reason: declared in the manifest but not loaded by the runtime

startup.structure: full-model nodes (rest pose), skins, inverse binds, materials, textures and clips; per primitive the full model geometry (retained), a source-derived reduction of it, or (diagnostic policies only) the adopted LOD geometry, in the same mesh/primitive order

geometry.rule: primitives of a multi-primitive mesh with at least 50% of their skin weight on the Head joint, and the only primitive of a single-primitive mesh, keep the full model's geometry byte for byte; every other primitive is an index-only reduction of its own full primitive (source-simplify.mjs), or kept whole where that finds no useful reduction; the adopted LOD is never shown
geometry.lowLevel: this geometry is the player's low level: a runtime distance or far level must not use the adopted LOD file for any primitive; retained primitives (heads, the whole primitive of single-primitive actors, unreduced primitives) stay full and source-simplified primitives keep exactly this file's geometry, so no level may swap retained primitives back to the adopted LOD; the full upgrade replaces geometry only, keeping pose and root
